summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K reporting a further extension of its Credit Agreement timeline and an update on strategic alternatives. On October 14, 2026, lenders led by Silver Point Finance extended the scheduled termination date and waived minimum liquidity and collateral coverage covenant relief through October 22, 2026. The company remains under a special committee-led strategic review, potentially including financing, recapitalization, restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, or other transactions. Management says significant progress has been made and discussions remain active with third parties and lenders. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed.
